Name: Joja Bus Recolor
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Pelican Town’s bus service has finally been restored and Joja Corp was proud to help. After the bus is repaired, Joja makes a few minor branding updates to ensure every trip to the desert is efficient, profitable, and legally associated with Joja.

[b]Config Options[/b]
A config.json file is generated after launching the game once. You can edit it manually, or change the options in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu.

Seasonal
true = Bus changes with each season.
false = Uses one year round bus texture.

JojaRouteRequired
false = Bus recolor appears after either the Community Center or Joja bus repair.
true = Bus recolor only appears after completing the Joja bus repair contract.

If you use Generic Mod Config Menu, these options can also be changed in-game.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]Want more Joja nonsense? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LeelooStardew/mods]my profile[/url] for more Joja-themed mods![/b]
